title: Small Animal Friends
hook: Space, diet, light, health: check the species.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: cute 3D small-animal storybook, cozy pastel habitats, soft rounded animals, clear isolated forms

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing care complexity across species
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written contrast; equipment belongs only to matching species
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: need-dimension cue -> recall beat -> target -> compare gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a kalimba paw/chirp figure with one soft shaker breath.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a kalimba paw/chirp figure with one soft shaker breath
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Small Animal Friends a needs-are-not-size song: fish, rabbits, dogs, mice, iguanas, quail and canaries may all be 'small' in a picture set yet require radically different space, diet, temperature, social and veterinary care.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares one care dimension at a time and rejects the idea that small body means simple care.
